flows.summary: User selects several files; all upload in parallel and appear in a list.

targets.summary: Panel with the file picker and the global uploading message.
List of selected files with per-file status.

states.summary: No files yet: shows an empty message.
At least one file is uploading: panel shows a progress message.
Row shows 'Uploading…' while its file is in flight.
Row shows 'Uploaded' once its upload resolves.

edgeCases.summary: Some files fail while others succeed.
edgeCases.rationale: Files upload independently in parallel, so one request can fail without the others; no rejection path exists.

edgeCases.summary: Uploads take much longer than the mock delay.
edgeCases.rationale: The mock resolves in under 1.5s; real uploads of large files can take far longer, and there is no cancel.

edgeCases.summary: Very long file names may push size and status out of the row.
edgeCases.rationale: File names are user-controlled and the row has no truncation rule.

questions.question: If 1 of 3 files fails, should the 2 successful files stay in the list?
questions.recommendedDefault: Yes, keep them and mark only the failed file.
questions.consequence: Determines whether a failure state is per-row or replaces the whole list.

questions.question: Should Retry re-upload only the failed file, or every file?
questions.recommendedDefault: Only the failed file, from a per-row Retry button.
questions.consequence: Adds a Retry action to the file row and requires a retry event.

notFound.summary: No rejection handling for uploads; an upload error would leave the row stuck on 'Uploading…'.
No retry or cancel action exists.
